target_zone_range.evidence_basis: Williamson — dedicated county treatment; Kerr — Kerr WMA vascular flora voucher list; Val Verde — Amistad vascular-plant inventory.

morphology.look_here_first: Start with the glossy black wiry rachis and delicate fan-shaped pinnules. Southern maidenhair grows from moist limestone seeps, springs, and shaded cliffs, with sori tucked beneath reflexed flap-like false indusia along the pinnule margins.
diagnostic_traits: glossy dark reddish-brown to black stipes and rachises
marginal sori covered by reflexed false indusia
strong association with moist limestone seeps and springs
